Hand-built miniatures of two SEC DERA Financial Statement Data Sets holding only Apple, with enough
lines to compute every aggregate the quality screen computes. Generated by a short script from the
figures below; the layout is the published one (tab-separated `sub.txt` and `num.txt` with the
documented headers).

`2023q4` holds the FY2023 10-K (accession 0000320193-23-000106, filed 2023-11-03) with three years
of income statement and cash flow (FY2021 to FY2023) and two balance sheets (FY2022, FY2023), which
is what a 10-K carries. `2024q4` holds the FY2024 10-K (0000320193-24-000123, filed 2024-11-01) with
FY2022 to FY2024 and balance sheets for FY2023 and FY2024. No figure is restated between the two.

Figures, USD millions except shares in thousands, as the two 10-Ks report them:

| | FY2021 | FY2022 | FY2023 | FY2024 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| net sales | 365,817 | 394,328 | 383,285 | 391,035 |
| cost of sales | 212,981 | 223,546 | 214,137 | 210,352 |
| gross margin | 152,836 | 170,782 | 169,148 | 180,683 |
| operating income | 108,949 | 119,437 | 114,301 | 123,216 |
| income before taxes | 109,207 | 119,103 | 113,736 | 123,485 |
| provision for income taxes | 14,527 | 19,300 | 16,741 | 29,749 |
| net income | 94,680 | 99,803 | 96,995 | 93,736 |
| operating cash flow | 104,038 | 122,151 | 110,543 | 118,254 |
| payments for PP&E | 11,085 | 10,708 | 10,959 | 9,447 |
| depreciation and amortisation | 11,284 | 11,104 | 11,519 | 11,445 |
| diluted shares (thousands) | 16,864,919 | 16,325,819 | 15,812,547 | 15,408,095 |
| cash and equivalents | | 23,646 | 29,965 | 29,943 |
| marketable securities, current | | 24,658 | 31,590 | 35,228 |
| commercial paper | | 9,982 | 5,985 | 9,967 |
| term debt, current | | 11,128 | 9,822 | 10,912 |
| term debt, non-current | | 98,959 | 95,281 | 85,750 |
| shareholders' equity | | 50,672 | 62,146 | 56,950 |
| total assets | | 352,755 | 352,583 | 364,980 |

`tests/test_dera_fundamentals.py` recomputes the screen's aggregates from this table by hand and
compares them to what `an.dera_fundamentals` produces from the files. FY2021 has no balance sheet
on purpose: its ROIC must be a hole, not a guess.
